svg.title: Local cached identity ownership mapping
svg.desc: Of 58 distinct cached application base identifiers on one Mac, 46 were mapped to verified current owners and 12 remained unresolved. Forty-five of the 46 mappings had explicit signed application-identifier binding. The unresolved group does not establish malicious ownership. This is a local cache, not an inventory of remote containers or records.
svg.text: One Mac · 58 distinct cached application base identifiers · November 19, 2026

g.text: 45 of the 46 mappings also had explicit signed application-identifier binding.
Unresolved ownership does not establish malicious activity.
The cache is not a complete inventory of remote containers or records.
Source: local audit report, executive summary · See owner-mapping.csv for values
